milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.subtitle: Your own checklist for getting ready — never seen by guests.

emptyNoDate.title: Set the wedding date first
emptyNoDate.body: The timeline is seeded from the wedding date, and none has been set yet. Add it in the wedding configuration, then come back here.

emptyNoMilestones.title: Nothing on the timeline yet
emptyNoMilestones.body: Create your first milestone to start tracking how the preparations are going.

internal.hint: Nothing to send — just tick it off once it's true.

kind.hint: Guest-facing milestones can carry an announcement you send to guests. Internal ones never notify anyone, on any channel.

delete.title: Delete this milestone?
delete.message: "{{title}}" will be removed from the timeline. This cannot be undone.

error.conflict: Someone else just updated this milestone. Reopen it to see the latest version.
error.generic: Something went wrong saving that. Please try again.

recipients.none: No guests currently match this audience

announcement.sendHint: Nothing goes out until you confirm.
announcement.sendDisabledHint: Choose a type and an audience, then save, to enable sending.
announcement.reachedHint: Already marked as reached — there's nothing to send.
announcement.sendConflict: This announcement could not be sent — the milestone may already have been sent, or changed, by someone else. We've refreshed it to show the latest state.

sendConfirm.title: Send this announcement?
sendConfirm.message: Send “{{title}}” ({{type}}) to {{audience}} — {{recipientCount}} guests, {{reachableCount}} reachable. This goes out immediately.

clearConfirm.title: Mark as not sent?
clearConfirm.message: This does not unsend anything — no announcement is recalled and nothing already delivered is reversed. It only removes the block that stops this milestone being sent again.

seed.conflict: This wedding already has its milestones on record — nothing was added. If the list still looks empty, try reloading.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This page explains how the site uses Google Analytics to understand overall visitor traffic.

analytics.title: Google Analytics
analytics.body: We use Google Analytics to see aggregate traffic on this site — things like visits, page views, and general device and geographic trends. We do not track individual actions or set up custom event tracking.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: Google Analytics sets cookies in your browser to help measure visits. These cookies are only set after you accept analytics below.

ipAnonymization.title: IP anonymization
ipAnonymization.body: Your IP address is anonymized before Google Analytics processes it, so it is not used to identify you individually.

googlePolicy.title: Google's privacy policy
googlePolicy.body: For more detail on how Google handles data collected through Analytics, see

changeChoice.title: Changing your choice
changeChoice.body: You can change your Accept/Decline choice at any time by clearing this site's data in your browser settings; you'll be asked again on your next visit.

notifications.title: Notifications
